policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document describes a whistleblower reporting tool launched by the EU AI Office. It is not itself a binding regulation but operationalizes enforcement of the AI Act. Legal protections for whistleblowers under the Whistleblower Directive apply to AI Act infringements only from 2 August 2026; until then, confidentiality is the primary protection. The tool covers general-purpose AI model providers specifically.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document frames AI governance primarily around protecting fundamental rights, public trust, and safety by enabling whistleblowers to report violations. The explicit mention of 'fundamental rights, health, or public trust' as the harms at stake, combined with references to the Whistleblower Directive and confidentiality protections, centers the frame on rights-based governance rather than competitiveness or security.
